mountains:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production panoramic game skybox layer.
The attached approved Cursed Peak mockup is a STYLE AND MOUNTAIN DESIGN REFERENCE only.
Generate ONLY one seamless horizontally tiling 360-degree distant mountain panorama for a game skybox. Wide 3:1 image, ideally 3072x1024. No panels, no labels, no game foreground, no HUD.
Match the winter mountains of the TOP LEFT daytime panel: dark grey rugged jagged crags, restrained pale snow stripes in gullies and on upper slopes, three distance layers with subtle grey valley mist. Elaborate credible geology, natural irregular varied peaks, charcoal rock, low-saturation neutral grey overcast lighting. No strong directional shadows because illumination will be controlled by shader. Never silhouette-edge glow.
Put the main mountain skyline in the middle band of the image: peaks range from 28 to 48 percent of height. Bottom half is solid continuous mountainous terrain fading down to darker grey, reaching every bottom pixel. Main most recognizable peak group slightly right of center. Sparse deep valley mist confined BELOW the uppermost skyline. No trees, buildings, water, snowflakes or clouds. Background ABOVE all mountain silhouettes MUST be an exact solid saturated magenta chroma key (#FF00FF), completely flat uniform color, clean crisp anti-aliased silhouette. No magenta inside the mountain terrain. The magenta background will be keyed out in engine. No transparency checkerboard. Left and right edges of terrain must connect smoothly for horizontal repetition; avoid distinctive peaks at the extreme join. Keep the entire terrain under matching dim neutral daytime illumination. The deliverable is only the mountain layer, not a finished scene.
clouds:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production cloud panorama texture for a dynamic game sky.
Attached approved Cursed Peak comparison board is only an art-direction reference. Generate ONE wide 3:1 tileable neutral grey CLOUD-ONLY panorama, ideally 3072x1024.
Match the layered heavy winter overcast clouds in the TOP LEFT daytime reference: broad rounded pearl-grey and charcoal cloud masses, fine natural vapor detail, lower thinner drifting veils. Deep soft shadows, credible volume, some silver-grey bright thin-cloud regions but no direct sun or moon. Natural nonuniform texture scales. Top third heavier darker ceiling, bottom third softer grey atmospheric cloud banks. No black featureless patches, no blown white holes, moderately restrained contrast. Neutral grey with barely perceptible cold tint. Left and right edges seamless for horizontal repetition. No mountains, terrain, horizon line, sky objects, blue openings, stars, planets, aurora, lightning, vortex, trees, foreground, HUD, text, panels or borders. The texture covers the entire canvas and is ONLY overcast winter cloud material, not a finished scene. Time of day, diffuse directional lighting, twilight rose and night tones will be added by shader later, so keep light diffuse and neutral now.
